							<div id="jet-toggle-content-7282" class="jet-toggle__content" data-toggle="2" role="region" data-template-id="false">
								<div class="jet-toggle__content-inner"><p>Yes. Scholarship recipients become members of <strong data-start="816" data-end="836">Pembroke College</strong>, one of Cambridge’s oldest and most prestigious colleges, providing access to a strong academic and networking environment.</p>

							<div id="jet-toggle-content-7283" class="jet-toggle__content" data-toggle="3" role="region" data-template-id="false">
								<div class="jet-toggle__content-inner"><p>Scholars must complete a <strong>two-month internship in Monaco</strong>, where they may work on projects such as:</p>
<ul>
<li>Raising awareness about the Foundation</li>
<li>Proposing new scholarships</li>
<li>Supporting strategic initiatives</li>
</ul>
<p>The internship is tailored to the candidate’s interests, and all related expenses are covered.</p>
</div>

<style>
.cmg-heading {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cmg-word {
  display: inline-block;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.cmg-word-inner {
  display: inline-block;
  transform: translateY(110%);
  will-change: transform;
}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.cmg-heading');

  wrappers.forEach((wrapper) => {

    // Evita doble ejecución
    if (wrapper.classList.contains('cmg-animated')) return;
    wrapper.classList.add('cmg-animated');

    // Buscamos el nodo de texto REAL
    const textEl = wrapper.querySelector('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, span');
    if (!textEl) return;

    const text = textEl.textContent.trim();
    textEl.innerHTML = '';

    const words = text.split(' ');

    words.forEach((word, index) => {
      const wordWrap = document.createElement('span');
      wordWrap.className = 'cmg-word';

      const wordInner = document.createElement('span');
      wordInner.className = 'cmg-word-inner';
      wordInner.textContent = word;

      wordWrap.appendChild(wordInner);
      textEl.appendChild(wordWrap);

      if (index < words.length - 1) {
        textEl.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '));
      }
    });

    const wordInners = textEl.querySelectorAll('.cmg-word-inner');

    gsap.to(wordInners, {
      y: '0%',
      duration: 0.6,
      ease: 'power3.out',
      stagger: 0.06,
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: wrapper,
        start: 'top 85%',
        toggleActions: 'play none none none'
      }
    });

  });
});
</script>
